Here's a concise implementation plan for the `is_happy` function:

- Check if the string length is less than 3; if so, return `False` immediately
- Iterate through the string examining every 3 consecutive characters (sliding window of size 3)
- For each window of 3 characters, verify all three are distinct (no duplicates); if any window has duplicates, return `False`, otherwise return `True` after checking all windows
